factProposals.value: Pushes system-owned asset fields to an ArcGIS feature layer and pulls GIS-owned fields back over the ESRI REST API (generateToken, query with paging, applyEdits).
ESRI ArcGIS Enterprise 11.3 is the GIS of record; this build talks to a SIMULATED stand-in that speaks the same REST shapes.

GIS sync failures are handled by kind: bad sign-in or rejected token (one refresh on expiry), timeouts with capped retries, and data mismatches on owned fields, unknown features or missing layer fields.

decisions.statement: The system owns ASSET_TAG, NAME, ASSET_TYPE, STATUS and LOCATION_DESC; GIS owns geometry and all other attributes. A GIS edit to a system-owned field is audited as gis.mismatch and overwritten.
decisions.rationale: neither side silently overwrites the other; agreed with the student

decisions.statement: applyEdits is never retried; adds look up the asset tag first.
decisions.rationale: a retried add could create a duplicate feature

decisions.statement: Every GIS transaction is audited: gis.push, gis.push_failed, gis.pull, gis.mismatch, gis.sync_run, gis.sync_failed.

limitations.statement: Not yet run against the City's real ArcGIS Enterprise 11.3; only against the SIMULATED stand-in.
